headline: Porto shares fall as Q3 2026 results show rising credit provisions
summary: Porto (PSSA3) shares declined following its Q3 2026 earnings report, which showed a rise in credit provisions by nearly 50% and a decline in recurring profit.
why: Porto is a major Brazilian insurance and financial services group; rising credit provisions indicate potential deterioration in loan portfolio quality.

impacts.name: Porto
impacts.why: Higher credit provisions directly reduce net income.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted negatively to the increased credit risk and the resulting impact on the company's profitability.
